stopped_because: round cap (2) reached with 1 high-severity defects

spec.headline: Bad debt must never breach the mutual reserve
spec.subhead: Containing systemic risk requires strict mechanical boundaries around each debt position.

blocks.text: Pooled Architecture: Slippage leaks into shared capital, forcing passive depositors to absorb mutual haircuts.
Isolated Engine: Structural bulkheads quarantine delinquent debt, locking losses inside the distressed position.

focal.reason: Emphasizes how explicit containment boundaries prevent default contagion across the venue.

defects.issue: Intended focal element lacks visual distinction and hierarchy
defects.reason: The 'Isolated Engine' block is styled identically to 'Pooled Architecture' in font size, color, and weight. It does not function as a focal point or communicate primary containment emphasis.
defects.fix: Enclose the 'Isolated Engine' block in an elevated card with a subtle 1px border using the brand accent tint, bold the 'Isolated Engine' title label, and increase its visual weight relative to the muted 'Pooled Architecture' column.

defects.issue: Severe vertical imbalance and dead space across lower canvas
defects.reason: All content is clustered in the upper 60% of the frame, leaving the bottom 40% completely empty and visually unanchored.
defects.fix: Increase vertical spacing: drop the comparison block down 120px, increase row padding, and vertically center the combined layout within the canvas margins.

defects.issue: Poor scannability and structural definition in comparison section
defects.reason: The titles ('Pooled Architecture:' and 'Isolated Engine:') run inline with body copy separated only by a faint, under-scaled vertical divider, reading as dense unformatted paragraphs rather than structured architecture comparisons.
defects.fix: Break titles into dedicated header lines above the descriptions, increase tracking to +0.02em, and replace the faint divider with two distinct side-by-side modular panels.
